review_type: independent arm-label-blinded code and behavior review
task: Sentinel 成员以及持有默认 UNSET 的Option，在复制或pickle往返时可能失败，某些Python版本还无法deepcopy参数对象。请保留哨兵的单例身份，使参数对象的复制和序列化保持有效默认值及名称。
summary: A/B 的生产代码仅注释不同，执行 AST 相同。两侧均用标准序列化协议按 Enum 类和成员名称恢复原哨兵，保留参数对象正常复制及默认值解析。两个本地 Python 版本上观察结果相同；未确认不安全修改或无当前需求的机制。

justified_behavior.title: 序列化按名称恢复现有 Enum 成员，保留单例身份
justified_behavior.evidence: 成员的值是各自 object()，新 hook 不尝试用往返后新建的 object 值查找 Enum，而是通过类与成员名找回规范实例。两个哨兵在 copy/copy.deepcopy 及 pickle 0..HIGHEST_PROTOCOL 往返后均保持 is 身份、名称和 repr，包含嵌套结构和字典键。

justified_behavior.title: 修复根部协议而不改变 Parameter/Option 的公开默认语义
justified_behavior.evidence: 没有在 Option 外包一层复制器，也没有把未设置默认值强行改成 None/False。源码原本用 is UNSET 区分用户未提供的值，布尔及多值 flag 默认值延迟解析；新协议保持这些身份检查。探针确认复制后的外层参数是新对象，名称/选项声明、普通 None、布尔 False、多值 ()、显式 falsy/default、flag_value 和 count 默认均保持。

justified_behavior.title: 标准复制所有权和现有错误行为未被吞掉
justified_behavior.evidence: 只为单例哨兵提供还原协议，未将参数对象的 copy/deepcopy 直接返回原对象，也未捕获复制或解析错误后假装成功。浅拷贝保留其普通列表别名语义，deepcopy/pickle 的列表默认值与选项列表可独立变更；必填参数及非法整数值仍分别抛 MissingParameter 和 BadParameter。

justified_behavior.title: 相同的名称恢复协议解决哨兵值身份问题
justified_behavior.evidence: __reduce_ex__ 的执行逻辑与 A 相同；它返回对实际类成员的查找，而不是创建新的哨兵或增加自有注册表。两个 Python 版本和所有本地 pickle 协议均保持 UNSET、FLAG_NEEDS_VALUE 的规范实例身份。

justified_behavior.title: 保留 raw UNSET 与延迟默认值解析的公共契约
justified_behavior.evidence: Parameter 与 Option 构造/解析没有改动；raw default 和 flag_value 保持 UNSET，不等于 CLI 中最终暴露的 None、False 或 ()。局部探针同时检查标准 Option、Argument、显式名称、别名及显式/推导默认值，结果与 A 一致。

justified_behavior.title: 没有新增无依据的包装、复制或错误兜底
justified_behavior.evidence: 该协议 hook 是本题实际序列化失败所需的机制。参数仍按普通浅拷贝、深拷贝和 pickle 规则生成新外层对象；深层列表所有权及 MissingParameter/BadParameter 失败路径与 A 相同。测试组织不同未被当作选优依据。

probe_method.isolation: Only permitted src/click packages were copied to a newly created reviewer temporary directory. Each variant/runtime was imported in its own local subprocess, with -B and PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1.
groups: Both Sentinel members retain identity through shallow/deep copy
Both members retain identity and representation through every available pickle protocol
Nested shared graphs and dictionary sentinel keys retain canonical members
Unset ordinary/boolean/multiple Option defaults, declarations and explicit names survive each copy mode
Optional Argument defaults and normalized names survive each copy mode
Ordinary shallow aliases remain shallow; deepcopy/pickle produce independently mutable default and option lists
Required and invalid typed value errors preserve their public classes and parameter names
Explicit None/zero/False/empty string, non-boolean flag activation and derived count defaults remain distinct from UNSET
probe_method.counting_limit: Eight overlapping probe groups per variant/runtime, not independent quality samples. Several base failures share the same underlying Enum pickle failure.

limitations: Local descriptive behavioral review, not an efficiency trial or a complete Click test suite.
Only the permitted task/base/A/B/patch artifacts were used. No current skill, label mapping, costs, reference fix, hidden grader or other pair result was opened during this review.

This agent has prior context from unrelated synthetic development fixture/oracle work; it is not a fresh reviewer with zero background. This Click serialization task was not one of those authored fixtures.
Runtime checks cover local Python 3.12.14 and 3.13.0 only, not every version implicated by the task or all operating systems.
The tests use standard serializable parameter state. They do not assert that arbitrary user callbacks, handles or other inherently unpicklable objects become serializable.
No assumption is made that labels correspond to the same experimental arm across different pairs; code length and test volume were not used to choose an arm.
